description: Capture a single still image from a video. Returns the saved image path and inlined base64 image data so vision models can inspect the frame.

includeBase64.description: Return base64 image data in response for vision models. Default: true.

inputPath.description: Path to the source video file.

outputPath.description: Destination image path ending in .png or .jpg (e.g. './thumb.png').

resolution.description: Optional scaled size formatted as 'WIDTHxHEIGHT', such as '1280x720'. Defaults to source resolution.

timestamp.description: Timestamp to capture, such as '00:00:05', '10', or 'midpoint' for the middle frame. Default: '00:00:01'.

name: extract_thumbnail
